Jyoti Narang is a Managing Solution Architect and Global SAP Treasury & Banking Transformation Lead with more than 20 years of experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance, Treasury & Risk Management, Bank Communication Management, In-House Cash and ISO 20022 payments. Jyoti has led transformations spanning 70+ legal entities for multinational enterprises in life sciences, medical technology and energy. Alongside client work, Jyoti builds working AI agents for treasury on SAP BTP and SAP Joule, writes for SAP Community and has submitted a book proposal on intelligent treasury and payment architecture to SAP Press. Jyoti is an active Toastmasters speaker.

98 words

Jyoti Narang is a Managing Solution Architect and Global SAP Treasury & Banking Transformation Lead who helps multinational enterprises turn treasury from a back-office function into a source of real-time decisions.

Over more than 20 years, Jyoti has led SAP S/4HANA Finance, Treasury & Risk Management, Bank Communication Management, In-House Cash and ISO 20022 programs across 70+ legal entities, including global banking modernization in life sciences, finance transformation through a medical-technology divestiture, and an integrated treasury and cash-management landscape for a global energy company. The career path runs from product ownership at SAP Labs to IBM and Capgemini, spanning North America, EMEA, APAC and LATAM.

Today Jyoti works where treasury meets enterprise AI. Jyoti designs and builds working prototypes, including an autonomous lockbox and customer-identification agent, an AI-assisted cash sweep engine and a treasury transformation ROI simulator, on clean-core principles with SAP BTP and SAP Joule. The guiding principle: AI proposes, SAP executes, and treasury remains in control.

Jyoti writes on intelligent payment architecture and AI-driven cash application for SAP Community, and has submitted a book proposal to SAP Press on next-generation SAP Treasury, banking and payment architecture. A committed Toastmasters member, Jyoti speaks on treasury innovation and the human side of transformation, making complex architecture clear enough for executives to act on.

Jyoti holds an MBA in Finance and a B.Tech in Electrical Engineering.

225 words
01

The Intelligent Payment Revolution: From Execution to Decision Intelligence

Treasury leaders · CFO organizations · SAP architects

Audiences leave knowing

  1. How Bank Communication Management, In-House Cash and ISO 20022 combine into a payment architecture that informs decisions, not just executes them.
  2. Where risk-based controls and AI-assisted exception management fit without weakening segregation of duties.
  3. A practical roadmap from fragmented bank connectivity to a governed global payment hub.
02

From Exception Queue to Intelligent Resolution: AI Agents for Cash Application

Order-to-cash leaders · Shared services · Finance operations

Audiences leave knowing

  1. Why unapplied cash persists even after lockbox and BAI2 automation, and what the remaining exceptions have in common.
  2. How an agent combines remittance evidence, ISO 20022 data and SAP open items into explainable match proposals.
  3. The guardrails that matter: confidence thresholds, review routing, duplicate checks and audit trails.
03

AI Proposes. SAP Executes. Treasury Stays in Control.

CIOs · CFOs · Transformation and architecture leaders

Audiences leave knowing

  1. A clean-core pattern for building AI on SAP BTP and Joule without modifying the digital core.
  2. How to define decision rights, approvals and evidence so auditors and treasurers trust AI recommendations.
  3. How to choose the first use cases and build a transparent business case leaders will fund.
